trainer/32198.htm.text: Master Gobie: Greetings! As past, present and future are connected by the strands of destiny, our meeting must have been foreordained. We disregard destiny at our peril, so let us embrace this moment. How may we be of service to each other?

trainer/32198-noteach.htm.text: Master Gobie: Our destinies are crossed. I am not sure that I have enough talent and ability to help you. I think you'd best look elsewhere...

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-01.html.text: Master Gobie: What business have you with me? Do you have an order? I did not receive an order for you. You may have come to the wrong person. Please check again.

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-02.html.text: Master Gobie: Ah, it's you. I heard that you were coming... Give Sione's orders to me...

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-04.html.text: Master Gobie: Why haven't you obeyed my order? Deliver this note to Captain Bathis of the Town of Gludio ...

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-05.html.text: Master Gobie: (Give him Bathis' documents) Back already, eh? Hmm, are you well?

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-06.html.text: Master Gobie: Speak up! Captain Bathis must have treated you with contempt, eh? A good lesson for you that not all the races in this Outer World see us the same way. Some respect us as equals, others see us simply as sword fodder in battle. Even individuals within a race treat us differently... As …

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-09.html.text: Master Gobie: Why are you still here? Hurry up! Take this document to Grand Master Tobias of the Dark Elf Guild in the Town of Gludio and come back.

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-10.html.text: Master Gobie: Ah! You have returned. And I see this has been another eventful errand... I too have been confused when dealing with some of these other races. The races of the Outer World and the evil creatures have complicated relations... Still, as an intelligence officer, it is my task to make se…

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-11.html.text: Master Gobie: Our life was certainly simpler before we left our island. Trying to understand this confusion and complexity is enough to give me a constant headache! What it tells us, though, is that we must all be more careful in our conduct. I suspect that our superiors have not told us everything…

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-13.html.text: Mastr Gobie: Deliver this report to Kamael Master Sione in Gludin Village . Go at once!

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-14.html.text: Master Gobie: Did you deliver the report? I have received deeply troubling news: our Xekerin Troops were all but annihilated. Our rangers discovered their corpses. Tak, the staff officer of the Ol Mahum we sought to capture, must have known of our plans! I have no additional troops to devote to thi…

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-17.html.text: Master Gobie: Well, if you say so... I have my doubts, but our options are limited. Do it, then! According to a report one of our men found on the body of one of the Xekerin Troops, Tak is hiding with the Maille Lizardmen. Take this Soul Crystal and go to the Maille Lizardmen Barracks . If you slay…

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-18.html.text: Master Gobie: Go to the Maille Lizardmen Barracks . There you must slay the Maille Lizardmen in order to force Tak, a staff officer of the Ol Mahum , to appear. When Tak is sufficiently weakened, he can be captured using this Soul Crystal. Hurry -- there is no time to waste!

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-19.html.text: Master Gobie: Well done! Now that Tak has been imprisoned within this Soul Crystal, he can be interrogated by our men... You have certainly proved your skill and courage. Take this Evaluation Report to a Kamael Grand Master and he will promote you to Warder. In fact, take it to Grand Master Gershwi…

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-20.html.text: Master Gobie: You have already passed the test and met the qualifications with flying colors... Hurry! If you submit the evaluation report of Special Unit Steelfile to a Kamael Grand Master , you will be able to change your class to Warder.

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-03.html.text: Master Gobie: (Reads the documents carefully.) Hmm... Good job... I will analyze the information you collected and draft further orders for you... (Master Gobie scribbles a note.) Here, take this letter to Captain Bathis of the Town of Gludio and return to me. While you deliver this, I will dispatc…

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-07.html.text: Master Gobie: Speak up! Captain Bathis must have treated you with contempt, eh? A good lesson for you, is that not all the races in this Outer World see us the same way. Some respect us as equals, others see us simply as sword fodder in battle. Even individuals within a race treat us differently...…

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-08.html.text: Master Gobie: Hmm... We have lost contact with the Xekerin Troops. That is not necessarily unusual during an operation, but they have remained out of contact longer this time... Still, since they are all elite warriors, I am not overly concerned...yet. I do have an another document for you to deliv…

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-12.html.text: Master Gobie: Our life was certainly simpler before we left our island. Trying to understand this confusion and complexity is enough to give me a constant headache! What it tells us, though, is that we must all be more careful in our conduct. I suspect that our superiors have not told us everything…

Q00063_PathOfTheWarder/32198-15.html.text: Master Gobie: You?! A novice like you would certainly be killed!

links.text: "I know I can do this. Trust me!"

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
